q: What news did Nehemiah hear about the wall of Jerusalem?
quote: The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.

q: When Nehemiah heard Jerusalem's wall was broken, what did he do?
why: He brought his sorrow to God.
quote: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

q: What was Nehemiah's job for the Persian king?
quote: (At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)

q: What did the king notice about Nehemiah's face?
quote: Why is your face sad, though you are not ill?

q: When the king asked, “What is your request?” what did Nehemiah do first?
quote: So I prayed to the God of heaven

q: What did Nehemiah ask the king to let him do in Judah?
quote: I ask that you send me to Judah, to the city where my fathers are buried, so that I may rebuild it.

q: When Nehemiah called Jerusalem's people to rebuild the wall, what did they reply?
why: They set their hands to good work.
quote: “Let us start rebuilding,” they replied, and they set their hands to this good work.

q: While rebuilding Jerusalem's wall, what did workers hold in their other hand?
quote: The laborers who carried materials worked with one hand and held a weapon with the other.

q: In how many days was Jerusalem's wall finished under Nehemiah?
quote: So the wall was completed in fifty-two days

q: When the wall was finished, what did Israel's enemies realize?
quote: for they realized that this task had been accomplished by our God.

q: Why did the king grant all Nehemiah's requests, as Nehemiah saw it?
a: God's gracious hand was on him
quote: And because the gracious hand of my God was upon me, the king granted my requests.

q: What did Nehemiah ask the king for to travel safely to Judah?
quote: may letters be given to me for the governors west of the Euphrates

q: What did Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem do when Nehemiah began rebuilding?
quote: they mocked us and ridiculed us

q: Who did Nehemiah say would give success to the wall builders?
quote: The God of heaven is the One who will grant us success.

q: Why did Jerusalem's wall rise to half its height so quickly?
a: The people had a mind to work
quote: for the people had a mind to work.

q: When enemies plotted against the wall builders, what did Nehemiah's people do?
why: They trusted God and stayed alert.
quote: So we prayed to our God and posted a guard against them day and night.

q: When enemies invited him to a meeting, what did Nehemiah answer?
why: He would not stop the work.
quote: I am doing a great work and cannot come down.

q: After the wall was built, who read the Book of the Law to the people?
why: He read from daybreak until noon.
quote: So Ezra read it aloud from daybreak until noon

q: When Ezra blessed the LORD before the law reading, what did the people say?
quote: all the people said, “Amen, Amen!”

q: Nehemiah told the people not to grieve, for what is your strength?
quote: Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

q: In which citadel was Nehemiah when he heard about Jerusalem?
why: It was in the month of Chislev.
quote: while I was in the citadel of Susa

q: Which Persian king did Nehemiah serve as cupbearer?
quote: in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes

q: Which of Nehemiah's brothers brought the news from Judah?
why: He came with men from Judah.
quote: Hanani, one of my brothers, arrived with men from Judah.

q: Who was the keeper of the king's forest whom Nehemiah asked for timber?
why: The timber was for gates and walls.
quote: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest

q: At which gate did the high priest Eliashib begin rebuilding?
quote: At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding.

q: In which month was Jerusalem's wall completed?
quote: on the twenty-fifth of Elul.

q: In front of which gate did the people gather to hear the law?
quote: all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate

q: Tobiah, who mocked Nehemiah's builders, was an official of which people?
quote: Tobiah the Ammonite official
